audit_metadata.scope: Complete UI/UX Elevation & Launch Readiness Assessment

executive_summary.primary_reason: Critical security vulnerabilities and build failures prevent production deployment
executive_summary.recommendation: Address critical blockers before launch, then proceed with staged rollout

P0_critical.impact: Critical security breach, user data compromise
P0_critical.remediation: Implement DOMPurify sanitization for all user content

P0_critical.impact: Unauthorized access to admin functions in production
P0_critical.remediation: Remove dev login from production builds
Fix import issues, type definitions, test utilities

P1_high.remediation: Increase all touch targets to 44px minimum

P1_high.impact: Content inaccessible to visually impaired users
P1_high.remediation: Adjust color palette to meet WCAG AA standards
Update vulnerable dependencies to safe versions

P2_medium.remediation: Fix test imports, mock configurations, timeout issues

P2_medium.impact: Slow load times on mobile/slow connections
P2_medium.location: Main bundle size and code splitting
P2_medium.remediation: Further optimize with advanced splitting strategies

P3_low.remediation: Apply design system patterns to remaining components

ab_test_recommendations.description: Compare user engagement with elevated vs standard components
Test impact of reducing tabs from 8 to 3 primary actions

mitigation_strategies: Fix all P0 critical issues before any deployment attempt
Implement staged rollout starting with internal users
Enhanced monitoring and alerting for first 48 hours
User communication about beta status and expected issues

user_experience_kpis: Support ticket volume < 5% of active users
Feature adoption rate > 60% for new elevated components

immediate_actions: STOP: Do not deploy to production in current state
FIX: Address all P0 critical security and build issues
TEST: Ensure comprehensive testing suite passes
VALIDATE: Complete security audit and penetration testing
short_term: Implement DOMPurify sanitization across all user input
Remove development authentication from production builds
Fix TypeScript compilation errors and test suite failures
Update vulnerable dependencies to secure versions
medium_term: Roll out elevated component patterns to remaining UI
long_term: Establish design system as single source of truth
